_comment: 3D model per footprint id, applied by scripts/applyModels.py (and by syncBoard/newBoard when they add parts). Offsets are KiCad's model offset (3D frame: y up), found by scripts/alignModel.py and checked against each model's own legs/pegs/lead feet. Vendor models are EasyEDA/LCSC STEPs in ../3d.

wallet:USB_C_Receptacle_HRO_TYPE-C-31-M-.note: GCT USB4105 body: the HRO part has no model; shell legs land on the HRO shell holes within 0.03 mm

wallet:Molex_54132-4062.note: 40 lead feet centred on the contact pads

wallet:Texas_DLA0010A_VSON-HR-10.note: the EasyEDA model's body hangs below z = 0

wallet:Texas_DLH0010A_WSON-10_2.2x2mm_P0.note: EasyEDA C19725033 model; 12/12 pads by scripts/alignModel.py

wallet:FPC_HC-FPC-1.0-6P-CSH25.note: EasyEDA C49166860 model; 8/8 pads by scripts/alignModel.py

wallet:SW_Alps_SKRTLAE010_HoleClear.note: EasyEDA/LCSC C110293. KiCad's library names a model for this land that it does not ship. Body +/-2.3 vs the fab outline +/-2.25, plunger tip 2.05 vs 2.04, height 3.35 (datasheet 3.3)

Connector_FFC-FPC:Jushuo_AFC07-S24FCA-00.note: EasyEDA/LCSC C262567. KiCad's library names a model for this land that it does not ship. Centred like the land; leads toward the contact row

wallet:Battery_AAA_Clip_MYOUNG_MY-AAA-19.note: MYOUNG's model from EasyEDA (LCSC C6937104); checked against MYOUNG's drawing WD-CP-0277 (arms 10.46 tall, 11 across) and against the footprint: base on the pad within 0.1 mm, end wall on the footprint's -x side (its fab mark), outward on the board

wallet:Battery_AAA_Clip_MYOUNG_MY-AAA-20.note: MYOUNG's model from EasyEDA (LCSC C6937107); checked against MYOUNG's drawing WD-CP-0277 (arms 10.46 tall, 11 across) and against the footprint: base on the pad within 0.1 mm, end wall on the footprint's -x side (its fab mark), outward on the board; the model's end wall is on +x, so turned 180
